slides.title: Two deadly flashpoints in southern Ethiopia
slides.body: Konso Zone and Moyale, reported Nov 4-5, 2026

slides.title: farmers killed on their way to the fields
slides.body: Borkena, citing local police: gunmen ambushed them in Arba Klala village, Kolme Woreda, Konso Zone, and abducted a fifth person.

slides.title: killed in a similar attack about a month earlier
slides.body: Residents say the attackers came from neighbouring Alle Zone. Alle Zone officials were not available for comment.

slides.title: districts now hit by clashes around Moyale
slides.body: Fighting on the Oromia-Somali border began Oct 18. A security official told Addis Standard it has intensified at night.

slides.title: Two mediation attempts ended without agreement
slides.body: Borana and Somali elders each told Addis Standard they will not give up land they consider theirs. Claims unverified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Support peaceful dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Borkena, Nov 4; Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 4, 2026
